ranked.headline: Deep learning models for drug synergy, toxicity, and molecular property prediction
ranked.summary: Multimodal and transfer-learning models now target synergy, kinetics, and toxicity endpoints, alongside new benchmarks for real-world applicability.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer gene regulatory networks and kinetics from single-cell data
ranked.summary: Statistical and deep-learning frameworks now pair prior knowledge or explicit model structure with scalable estimation on single-cell and multi-omics data.

ranked.headline: Learning models couple omics, pathology and spatial data to predict outcomes and subtypes
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous omics, imaging and spatial inputs are now modelled jointly, from spatial QSP calibration to pancreatic precancer mapping.

ranked.headline: PLM embeddings paired with structure for protein function and interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Recent November 2025 entries apply protein language model embeddings across binding, allergenicity, lipid, and interaction prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Sequencing-based methods are benchmarked against noisy or indirect measurements
ranked.summary: Nanopore basecalling, cfDNA-based expression inference, and enhancer modeling are being evaluated against orthogonal or noisy reference data.

ranked.headline: Deep models predict methylation, TF binding and expression from sequence context
ranked.summary: Recent publications and preprints extend sequence-based deep learning to personalized genomes, haplotype context, and long-read variant calling.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and new tools for variant calling, CNV, and pangenome representation
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks of de novo and WGS variant callers, plus T2T-CHM13 mapping gains, reassess how sequencing-derived variants are called and represented.

ranked.headline: Temporal trajectories of spatial transcriptomic states inferred from multi-timepoint data
ranked.summary: Multi-timepoint spatial transcriptomics now enables explicit modeling of temporal ordering at the level of spatial domains and microenvironments.

ranked.headline: Pretrained and attention models extend RNA function and modification prediction
ranked.summary: Recent items pair pretrained RNA and gene language models with attention architectures for diverse nucleic acid prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Packaged pipelines and tools turn sequencing reads into taxonomic and functional results
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications release containerized, validated tools for converting raw sequence data into interpretable taxonomic and functional results.

ranked.headline: Generative protein language models design antigen-binding antibodies and TCRs
ranked.summary: Recent publications couple generative sequence models with learned binding or immunogenicity scoring for immune-targeted and antimicrobial design.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer cell identity and lineage from single-cell and imaging data
ranked.summary: Recent work benchmarks LLMs for scRNA-seq cell annotation and formalizes reference selection for cross-dataset transfer.

ranked.headline: Graph and contrastive learning now target spatial transcriptomics domains and expression
ranked.summary: Recent methods pair graph encoders with contrastive or diffusion objectives to recover spatial domains and expression from multislice and histology data.

ranked.headline: Statistical methods refine genetic association and variant-trait inference
ranked.summary: Recent methods extend association testing to higher-order epistasis, cell-state resolution, heterosis, sparse polygenic scores, and microbiome data.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and simulation methods test RNA structure, ligand kinetics and nucleotide…
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks and blind challenges test how well computational methods recover RNA ensembles, ligand kinetics and sequence-model fitness.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose scorer bias as structure-aware models advance binding prediction
ranked.summary: Independent benchmarks of AlphaFold3 and ΔΔG predictors on new datasets are exposing systematic biases in complex prediction.

ranked.headline: Learned and rule-based tools for genomic data preparation, simulation, and analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications add LLM-based metadata reconstruction and foundation-model ATAC-seq analysis to established structural variant tooling.

ranked.headline: Software tools packaging single-cell, spatial, breeding and metabolic modeling methods
ranked.summary: Web-based, containerized and differentiable tools make published computational methods directly usable across single-cell, spatial and metabolic work.

ranked.headline: Mobile genetic elements and gene variation mapped across bacterial genome collections
ranked.summary: Large genome collections now enable systematic profiling of phage, plasmid, and transposon exchange in bacterial pathogens and gut viromes.

ranked.headline: Graph neural networks predict microbial, drug, and phage-bacterium associations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply graph and hypergraph learning to predicting biological association networks spanning microbes, drugs, genes, and phages.

ranked.headline: Language models and network methods predict hidden protein functional states
ranked.summary: Protein language models and network-based methods now target disorder, phase separation, missing proteins, and dark kinases across the proteome.

ranked.headline: Methylome plasticity and transposon activity shape plant and human genome evolution
ranked.summary: Long-read methylation profiling and 1,075-methylome analyses now resolve epigenomic variation across temperature, tissues, and evolutionary lineages.

ranked.headline: Graph and transformer networks integrate multi-omics data for disease prediction
ranked.summary: Recent publications apply graph, Transformer, and self-supervised architectures to multi-omics data for subtyping, survival, and interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: Open tools integrate multi-omics data and QC into reproducible analysis workflows
ranked.summary: Recent releases package multi-omics integration, proteomics QC, and scRNA-seq analysis as openly available, reusable tools for downstream analysis.

ranked.headline: AI tools extend structure prediction and analysis across biomolecular tasks
ranked.summary: Preprints and a published tool apply deep learning to structure prediction, crystal detection, genome annotation and variant interpretation.

ranked.headline: Multimodal Deep Learning Advances Biomedical Prediction With Uncertainty Estimates
ranked.summary: Deep models are now targeting clinically actionable endpoints such as cancer detection and MSI/TMB status, with reliability estimates reported alongside.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and MS workflows predict and resolve protein modifications
ranked.summary: Modification-aware models now predict lysine lactylation sites, retention times for unseen modifications, and coexisting PTM isoforms from MS data.

ranked.headline: Automated extraction and linkage of bioinformatics knowledge into structured resources
ranked.summary: Recent papers apply LLM extraction, provenance-tracked mapping, and open pipelines to bioinformatics infrastructure rather than individual analyses.

ranked.headline: Algorithmic speedups for alignment, motif scoring, genome sizing and DNA storage reads
ranked.summary: Each tool targets a specific memory or runtime bottleneck in large-scale or real-time sequence-data workloads.

ranked.headline: Post-association inference adapted for relatedness, method disagreement and specificity
ranked.summary: Related-individual samples and genomic SEM pathway questions demand inference procedures beyond standard GWAS association testing.

ranked.headline: Systems models link brain network causality, neuronal metabolism, and callosal genetics
ranked.summary: Systems-level models now tie causal brain connectivity, neuron-specific metabolism, and callosal genetics to neurological and psychiatric disease.

ranked.headline: Models refine interpretation of rare-disease, mitochondrial and KCNQ1 variants
ranked.summary: WGS of 12,568 rare-disease families shows complex de novo SVs are underestimated, alongside new variant classifiers for KCNQ1 and mitochondrial disease.

ranked.headline: Network and multiomics models nominate repurposing candidates from disease and target data
ranked.summary: Explainable ML, gene networks and persistent-Laplacian ranking now nominate repurposing candidates across opioid and Alzheimer's disease data.

ranked.headline: TaxaGO adds phylogenetic context to gene ontology enrichment across species
ranked.summary: Recent tools add phylogenetic context to GO enrichment and extend multiomics relationship mining and community-curated gene cluster databases.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level reference genomes for an annelid, cricket, and tachinid fly
ranked.summary: Three preprints pair new genome assemblies with annotation, reprocessed multi-omic datasets, or mitogenome-based comparative analysis.

ranked.headline: Generative, ligand-based, and covalent docking methods for small-molecule discovery
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and reviews of ligand-based and covalent methods sharpen how generative and screening tools are evaluated against defined targets.

ranked.headline: Computational mapping of allosteric and immune-evasion mechanisms in viral systems
ranked.summary: Structure-based models now capture how sequence and interface energetics govern viral immune evasion, RNA allostery, and designed protein stability.
